mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM BOOK B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.NO WHERE B.CANCEL_DATE IS NULL AND M.COMPANY_NO = #{companyNo}
AND B.END_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND B.START_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND M.NAME LIKE '%' || #{memberName} || '%'
AND B.BOOK_PLACE LIKE '%' || #{bookPlace} || '%'
AND B.BOOK_PURPOSE LIKE '%' || #{bookPurpose} || '%'
ORDER BY B.BOOK_NO DESC

SELECT
FROM BOOK B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.NO WHERE B.BOOK_NO = #{bookNo} AND B.CANCEL_DATE IS NULL
SELECT M.COMPANY_NO FROM BOOK B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.NO WHERE B.BOOK_NO = #{bookNo}
